entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the concepts, theories and principles in Chemistry
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Chemistry
entries.learning_activity: (a) Describe the concept of the atom (Dalton’ s atomic theory, Bohr’ s atomic theory, atomic mass and quantum theory)
teaching_learning_activities: ICT based learning: Organise students to watch simulations, animations, videos or diagrams that illustrate the structure of an atom and write appropriate report
entries.assessment: The concept of the atom is clearly described
resources: Pictures, diagrams, simulations, animations or videos illustrating the structure of an atom
entries.references: TIE, Chemistry for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the concepts, theories and principles in Chemistry
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Chemistry
entries.learning_activity: (c) Explain the concept of chemical bonding and the interactions of atoms to form molecules
teaching_learning_activities: Hands-on experience activities: Guide students to observe different materials with different types of chemical bonding and build models of different molecules using locally available materials
Group discussion: Guide students to discuss the interactions of atoms to form molecules and interpret the physical properties of different substances basing on their structures and bonding

entries.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate an understanding of changes in the physical and chemical properties of elements according to their positions in the periodic table
